parsed.reason: Multiple critical failures: (1) Question is in Chinese but answer is entirely in English—violates the core requirement. (2) The question asks about the greatest footballer in history; the answer completely ignores this and talks about weather instead. (3) Contains invented specific data (temperature, weather forecast). (4) Points to a website and app. (5) Ends with a question. (6) Uses emoji and greeting language ("Great question!"). (7) Offers to do something later ("set a reminder"). This is evasion of an answerable opinion question paired with completely off-topic content and language mismatch.
